title: Key transit routes
steps: Airport → Lisbon center: Metro red line, Aeroporto → Saldanha (≈20 min). Buy a Navegante card (€0.50) + fare (€1.92 single, or €1.72 with prepaid zapping credit) at the station machine.

Around Lisbon: Metro for cross-city hops; Carris trams/buses for the hills (Tram 28 single fare €3.30 cash onboard, or €1.72 with Navegante zapping — a 24h Carris+Metro pass is €7.25 and breaks even after ≈3 tram rides).

Lisbon → Sintra (day trip): CP Sintra line from Rossio station, ≈40 min (exact current fare not independently confirmable — cp.pt blocks automated verification, budget a few euros each way). At Sintra station, buy the 24h Scotturb bus pass (€10.96, confirmed) covering bus 434 to Pena Palace/Moorish Castle and bus 435 to Monserrate.

Lisbon → Porto: CP Alfa Pendular from Oriente or Santa Apolónia station, ≈2h45m (exact fare not independently confirmable — cp.pt is a JS-heavy site that blocks automated fetch; aggregator estimates run ≈€25–34 2nd class, book at cp.pt to confirm and reserve a seat).
Around Porto: the historic center (Ribeira, Clérigos, São Bento) is walkable; Porto Metro Line D crosses the upper deck of the Dom Luís I Bridge to Vila Nova de Gaia for the port wine cellars.
